english:
Hitting an enemy of the <link Miniboss Tier or higher [#CombatantClassifications] /> grants a stack of 'Down the Line'. Maximum of 10 stacks.

Down the Line grants 15% increased Weapon Damage against <link Rank-and-File and Elite Combatants [#CombatantClassifications] />. Killing one of these enemies consumes a stack.

1 second cooldown between gaining stacks.

source.text:
4 Piece | Down the Line

Upon scoring a hit against Miniboss+ Combatants:
Grants a stack of Down the Line, up to a maximum of 10 stacks. 
Incurs a 1 second cooldown between gaining stacks.

Down the Line:
15% increased Weapon Damage against Rank-and-File and Elite Combatants.
Consumes a stack upon killing Rank-and-File and Elite Combatants.
